overview: The board approved a fence variance for a residential property and postponed six other scheduled cases due to applicant requests and noticing errors.

items.title: Case Continuations
items.summary: Continued cases A-2023-14, A-2023-21, A-2023-23, A-2023-24, A-2023-25, and A-2023-26 to February 29 because of applicant requests and clerical errors in the public notices.

items.title: 66 Irving Street (A-2023-22)
items.summary: Approved a variance to install an eight-foot fence at 66 Irving Street. The board found that a significant topographical elevation difference between adjacent properties created a privacy hardship that justified exceeding the standard six-foot limit.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Announced the appointment of a new associate member and coordinated the schedule for upcoming special meetings regarding a Chapter 40B project. Staff and board members discussed preparing memos and coordinating with the Building Department to streamline the heavy caseload anticipated for February.
